data.name: Shersingh
data.gender_notes: Shersingh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shersingh means the king of the lions. It is derived from the words 'shahr' meaning fort and 'singh' meaning lion. This name signifies power, courage, and royalty. It is a name that is often given to boys in Hindu families as it is believed to bring good luck and prosperity. The name Shersingh carries the meaning “Lion King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Shersingh usually hope their child will grow to embody lion king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shersingh is a spiritual name that represents the inner strength and courage of an individual. It signifies the warrior within, ready to face any challenges that come their way. It is a name that is deeply connected to the Hindu tradition and is believed to bring blessings and prosperity.
data.etymology: Shersingh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shersingh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shersingh is deeply rooted in Hindu culture. The lion symbolizes strength, courage, and power. In Hinduism, the lion is associated with several gods, such as Narasimha, who is a part-lion, part-human form of Lord Vishnu. This name is a reflection of the values that are highly regarded in Hindu culture - strength, courage, and fearlessness.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the lion is also considered a vehicle of God. It represents the guardian of the temples and is believed to ward off evil. Having a name like Shersingh is seen as a spiritual blessing as it signifies being protected by the divine and possessing the qualities of a guardian and protector. It is a reminder to live with courage, strength, and fearlessness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shersingh: Lion King. Signifies strength, courage, and fearlessness. The lion symbolizes regal power and leadership in Hindu mythology. The name invokes the spirit of a brave and noble leader.
